verifications.claim: Israel is conducting airstrikes in southern Lebanon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Israeli forces and Iran-backed Hezbollah militants have been fighting'; R2: 'The IDF began a series of airstrikes on 23 September'; R3: 'Israel conducted hundreds of airstrikes across southern Lebanon'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm ongoing Israeli airstrikes in southern Lebanon.

verifications.claim: Israel is conducting ground incursions in southern Lebanon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Israel has moved thousands of troops across the border into Lebanon'; R2: 'On 1 October, IDF troops crossed the border into Lebanon'; R3: 'Israeli ground operations in southern Lebanon began on 16 March 2026'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly describe ground incursions and invasions into southern Lebanon.

verifications.claim: Hezbollah is an Iranian-backed paramilitary group.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Iran-backed Hezbollah militants'; R2: 'Hezbollah, citing solidarity with Palestinians'; R3: 'Iran-backed Hezbollah militia'
verifications.reasoning: All sources consistently describe Hezbollah as Iranian-backed and paramilitary/militant.

verifications.claim: Hezbollah has launched missiles into northern Israel.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Hezbollah fired a barrage across the border'; R2: 'launching rockets into northern Israel'; R3: 'Hezbollah launched several projectiles into northern Israel'
verifications.reasoning: Direct mentions of Hezbollah launching missiles/rockets into northern Israel.

verifications.claim: Israel aims to dismantle Hezbollah’s military infrastructure.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'remove the threat that Hezbollah's military capabilities was posing'; R5: 'dismantle Hezbollah's military infrastructure'
verifications.reasoning: Sources state Israel's goal to dismantle/remove Hezbollah's military infrastructure.

verifications.claim: Israel aims to stop rocket fire on its border residents.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'prevent Hezbollah from firing missiles into northern Israel'
verifications.reasoning: R1 directly states Israel's defensive aim to stop missile fire on northern Israel.

verifications.claim: Israel aims to push Hezbollah back from its border.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'take control of the entire area south of the Litani River'; R2: 'withdraw its forces north of the Litani River'
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe Israel's intent to push Hezbollah north of Litani/border area.

verifications.claim: Hezbollah launched rockets into Israel in March 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'On 2 March, Hezbollah launched several projectiles into northern Israel'
verifications.reasoning: R3 explicitly states Hezbollah launched projectiles on March 2, 2026.

verifications.claim: Hezbollah launched rockets into Israel following US-Israel actions against Iran.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Following the U.S.–Israeli joint strikes on Iran on 28 February 2026, Hezbollah... on March 2'
verifications.reasoning: R3 confirms Hezbollah attacks followed US-Israel strikes on Iran.

verifications.claim: Israel stated that the ceasefire it reached with Iran does not apply to Hezbollah in Lebanon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'Defence Minister Israel Katz said... did not apply to Hezbollah'; R7: 'Netanyahu says ceasefire excludes Lebanon'; R11: 'Trump: Iran truce doesn’t cover Lebanon'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources quote Israeli officials stating ceasefire excludes Lebanon/Hezbollah.

verifications.claim: Israel claims it has discovered significant Hezbollah military infrastructure near the border.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'The IDF said it had uncovered Hezbollah tunnels, weaponry, and invasion plans in villages near the border'
verifications.reasoning: R2 directly states IDF discovered Hezbollah infrastructure near border.

verifications.claim: Israel claims it has discovered Hezbollah attack plans near the border.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'found Hezbollah plans to launch an attack similar to Hamas' 7 October attacks'
verifications.reasoning: R2 confirms Israel found Hezbollah attack plans near border.

verifications.claim: There was a Hamas attack on October 7, 2023.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Hamas-led attack on Israel' on October 7, 2023
verifications.reasoning: R2 explicitly references the Hamas attack on October 7, 2023.

verifications.claim: Israel is looking to dismantle Hezbollah's presence in southern Lebanon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'remove the militant group from the area'; R5: 'dismantle Hezbollah's military infrastructure'
verifications.reasoning: Sources indicate Israel's aim to remove/dismantle Hezbollah presence in south Lebanon.

verifications.claim: Israel's strikes have killed over 1,500 people in Lebanon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R7: 'more than 1,500 people have been killed in Israeli attacks since March 2'; R10: 'more than 1,530 people in Lebanon'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm over 1,500 killed by Israeli strikes in Lebanon.

verifications.claim: Israel's strikes have displaced roughly one million people.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: '1.4 million+ Lebanese civilians displaced'; R3: 'over 1.2 million Lebanese nationals'; R6: 'about 1.3 million people — most of them Shiites — to flee'
verifications.reasoning: 'Roughly one million' matches sources citing 1.2-1.4 million displaced.

verifications.claim: Israel has intensified its attacks in Beirut.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Israeli aircraft struck the southern suburbs of Beirut'; R4: 'Israel has intensified its attacks in Beirut'; R7: 'extensive overnight strikes in central Beirut'
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe increased/escalated strikes in Beirut areas.

verifications.claim: Israel has intensified its attacks in the Bekaa Valley.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'An Israeli air strike destroyed three houses in the Bekaa Valley'; R4: 'Israel has intensified its attacks in the Bekaa Valley'
verifications.reasoning: Direct mentions of intensified or multiple strikes in Bekaa Valley.

verifications.claim: Israel says it will continue until its security goals are met.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'displaced Lebanese residents will not be allowed back until Israel decides that its northern border is safe'; R11: 'the army “will continue to strike the Hezbollah terror organization and seize every opportunity"
verifications.reasoning: Sources quote Israel continuing operations until security/border safety achieved.
